name: io.github.knowledgepa3/gia-mcp-server
title: GIA — Governed Intelligence Architecture
description: Runtime AI governance: decision gates, human approval, hash-chained audit, compliance mapping.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for a persistent forensic audit trail (optional — the governance engine runs in-memory without it)

environmentVariables.name: GIA_TOOL_VISIBILITY
environmentVariables.description: Tool visibility tier: public | tenant | operator (optional — local stdio defaults to operator)

environmentVariables.name: GIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the hosted GIA platform (optional — only needed when connecting to gia.aceadvising.com instead of running embedded)

headers.description: Bearer <GIA_API_KEY> — the endpoint accepts an Authorization bearer token or a GIA_API_KEY query parameter. It does NOT accept x-api-key.
headers.name: Authorization
